code:
Rotation job moves records matching criteria
(e.g. 'closed > N years ago') out of the
live table into an archive table, or deletes
per a defined retention rule.

The data isn't gone from history.
It's gone from every live query's workload.
caption: Archiving removes cost from live queries, not from the organization's record.

code:
Course 12: good indexing
  -> finds rows faster within a table's size

This lesson: archiving
  -> shrinks the size the index has to cover

Same goal: query performance.
Leaving out either leaves gains on the table.
caption: A smaller active table is faster to query and index, regardless of indexing quality.
